en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style landscape view of a small European town on a river. In the foreground, a narrow road and path lead to a simple riverside landing where several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand near a small pier. A white passenger boat with an enclosed cabin and people on board moves along the river. A low bridge crosses one branch of the river to the left. Beyond, open fields stretch towards a compact town with multi‑storey houses and several prominent church towers or steeples. Low, rounded hills form the background under a hazy sky.
